description.zh-CN: 资源列表多级右键菜单与虚拟机原生配置快捷入口，复用 CloudTower 官方菜单、对话框和确认流程。
description.en-US: Cascading resource-row menus and VM shortcuts reuse CloudTower native menus, dialogs and confirmation flows.

compatibility.tower: CloudTower 4.9.0 public DOM; framework 0.2 candidate, live validation pending.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 修复A/B/A后原生入口恢复，并严格限定单次准确原生reset边；外部排队导航和重复边仍使操作失效，不凭当前URL相等继续。保留退休、代次和身份守卫及自身失败提示。0.5.8本地候选未通过独审、未部署，0.5.9待真实环境测试。
releaseNotes.en-US: Recover native entries after A/B/A using a single exact native reset edge. Queued external navigation and duplicate edges still cancel; current URL equality cannot establish ownership. Preserve retirement, generation and identity checks and visible failure diagnostics. The 0.5.8 local candidate was rejected and never deployed; 0.5.9 awaits real-environment testing.
